info.title: FitFlow API
info.description:
REST API for the FitFlow coaching operations platform.

FitFlow enables online personal trainers to manage clients, deliver workout and meal plans,
collect check-ins, and process payments — all through WhatsApp or Telegram.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Supabase JWT access token passed as a Bearer token:
```
Authorization: Bearer <supabase_access_token>
```

## Subscription Tiers
Some endpoints enforce subscription tier requirements (STARTER, PRO, STUDIO).
Responses include `code: TIER_REQUIRED` or `code: LIMIT_REACHED` when access is restricted.

## Rate Limits
| Endpoint Group | Limit |
|---------------|-------|
| General | 100 req/min |
| `/intake`, `/p/*` | 10 req/min |
| `/webhooks`, `/telegram/webhook` | 200 req/min |

## Error Format
All errors return JSON with at minimum an `error` field:
```json
{ "error": "Description of what went wrong", "code": "OPTIONAL_ERROR_CODE" }
```

BearerAuth.description: Supabase JWT access token. Obtained via Supabase Auth (email/password login).

get.description: Returns server status and current timestamp. Used by Railway/Render health probes.
Returns all clients belonging to the authenticated coach. Supports pagination.

post.description: Creates a new client for the authenticated coach. Status defaults to PENDING_PAYMENT. Optionally creates a SessionBlock for session-based billing.

403.description: Client limit reached for subscription tier

get.description: Returns a single client with their assignments (including plan), last 20 check-ins, last 20 workout logs, and last 10 messages.

patch.description: Updates client fields. Status transitions are NOT allowed here — use dedicated flows (payment confirmation, intake completion, plan assignment).

post.description: Queues an onboarding intake job that sends the intake form to the client via their preferred channel.

get.description: Returns the AI-computed risk score for a client. Score ranges 0-100 with levels LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL. Includes factor breakdown and AI-generated suggestion.
Returns the authenticated coach's full profile including computed fields: stripeConnected, whatsappConnected, telegramConnected, telegramDeepLink.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated coach's profile. Slug changes create a SlugRedirect (90-day) for the old slug. Slug must be 3-30 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, and not a reserved word.

post.description: Marks the coach's onboarding as completed.

get.description: Returns the connection status for WhatsApp and Telegram channels, including links and bot usernames.

post.description: Creates a Stripe Express Connect account (if not already linked) and returns the onboarding URL. Coaches use this to receive client payments.

get.description: Returns a login link to the coach's Stripe Express dashboard for managing payouts and viewing transactions.
Returns all workout plans belonging to the authenticated coach. Each plan includes a computed `daysPerWeek` field.

post.description: Creates a new workout plan with days and exercises. Each day must have at least 1 exercise. Max 14 days per plan.

201.description: Plan created with all nested relations

post.description: Uses Claude AI to generate a workout plan based on optional client context and free-text instructions. Returns a complete plan with exercises from the coach's library.

get.description: Returns publicly available workout plan templates. Filterable by comma-separated tags.

200.description: Array of templates with daysPerWeek and totalExercises

post.description: Creates a copy of a public template as the coach's own plan.

get.description: Returns a single workout plan with all days and exercises.

put.description: Replaces the plan's title, description, and all days/exercises. Existing days are deleted and re-created.

delete.description: Deletes a plan and cascades to days, exercises, and related workout logs.

post.description: Creates an exact copy of a plan including all days and exercises. Title is suffixed with '(copy)'.
Assigns a workout plan to a client. Any existing active assignment is deactivated. scheduleDays is an array of ISO weekday numbers (1=Monday, 7=Sunday).

get.description: Returns all workout plan assignments for a client, including the plan details.
Searches the local exercise database by name and/or category.
Searches the external YMove exercise library. Requires at least `search` or `muscleGroup` parameter. Returns exercises without video URLs (fetched on delivery).

post.description: Imports an exercise from YMove into the local database by its ymoveId. Upserts if the exercise already exists.

get.description: Searches both the local database and YMove API simultaneously, deduplicates results. Requires query of at least 3 characters.
Returns all meal plans belonging to the authenticated coach.

post.description: Creates a new meal plan with days and meal entries.
Uses Claude AI to generate a meal plan based on optional client context and instructions.

get.description: Returns publicly available meal plan templates. Filterable by comma-separated tags.

post.description: Creates a copy of a public meal plan template as the coach's own plan.

get.description: Returns a single meal plan with all days and entries.

put.description: Replaces meal plan title, description, and all days/entries.

post.description: Assigns a meal plan to a client. Deactivates any existing active meal assignment.

patch.description: Updates assignment status (isActive) or schedule days.

get.description: Searches the meal database by name and/or category.

post.description: Creates a new meal in the database with optional macro data.

get.description: Searches the Spoonacular API for ingredients with nutritional data. Min 2 character query.
Searches the Spoonacular API for recipes with optional diet and calorie filters.
Returns full recipe details from Spoonacular by ID.
Returns summarized conversations for the coach. Pinned conversations appear first, then sorted by most recent message.
Returns paginated messages for a specific client conversation.

post.description: Sends a text message to the client via their preferred channel. For WhatsApp, checks the 24-hour messaging window — if closed, sends via approved template instead.

delete.description: Deletes all messages in a client conversation.

get.description: Returns whether the 24-hour WhatsApp messaging window is open for this client, when it expires, and what message types are allowed.

patch.description: Toggles whether a conversation is pinned to the top of the message list.

post.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout session for a client payment. The coach must have Stripe Connect onboarding completed. Available on all subscription tiers.
Manually confirms a bank transfer payment. Creates a Payment record and transitions the client status. PRO/STUDIO tier required.
Sends the coach's bank transfer details to a client via their preferred channel. Creates a PENDING payment record.

get.description: Returns all payments for the coach's clients with client name resolved.

post.description: Sends a payment reminder message to the client via their preferred channel.

get.description: Returns a receipt URL (Stripe payments) or HTML receipt (bank transfers).
Returns all available tiers with pricing in the coach's billing currency and feature limits.
Returns the coach's current subscription including tier, status, usage counts (clients, plans, meal plans, offers), trial info, and limits.

post.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout session for subscribing to a tier. Creates a Stripe Customer if one doesn't exist.
Returns a Stripe Customer Portal session URL for managing the subscription (cancel, change payment method, view invoices).
Upgrades or downgrades the coach's subscription. Changes take effect immediately for upgrades, at period end for downgrades.

get.description: Returns the coach's Stripe invoices with hosted and PDF download links.
Returns all leads for the coach. Filterable by status. Includes offer info and unread message count.

patch.description: Updates lead status and/or notes. Only `status` and `notes` fields are allowed.

post.description: Converts a lead into a client record. Creates the Client, migrates messages, and marks the lead as CONVERTED.
Triggers the intake questionnaire for a lead via their channel.

get.description: Returns paginated messages for a lead conversation.

post.description: Sends a text message to a lead via Telegram.

get.description: Returns all offers for the coach with lead count.

post.description: Creates a new marketing offer. The slug must be unique within the coach's offers.

get.description: Returns an offer with its associated leads.
Returns aggregated KPIs for the coach: total clients, active plans, workout count, compliance rate, revenue, at-risk count, channel breakdown, new leads. Requires PRO or STUDIO tier.
Returns recent events for the coach with resolved client names.
Returns platform-wide KPIs: total coaches, clients, active subscriptions, MRR, revenue, tier breakdown. **Requires platform admin role** (PLATFORM_ADMIN_IDS env var).
Paginated, searchable, filterable list of all coaches on the platform. Includes subscription info and client count.
Returns a single coach with subscription, client count, revenue, and recent events.
Returns MRR breakdown by tier, monthly revenue trend, payment volume, churn rate, and recent subscription changes.
Returns platform-wide events with filtering by event type, coach, and date range.
Returns all short links for the coach with computed shortUrl and click counts.
Resolves a short link code to its target URL. Increments click counter. No authentication required.
Returns public profile info for a coach by their slug. No authentication required. Handles slug redirects (90-day window). Query param `c` sets channel context.

post.description: Records a profile analytics event (viewed, channel_click, redirect, link_copied). IP is hashed for privacy.

get.description: Returns coach and offer info for a landing page. No auth required.

post.description: Creates a new lead from a public offer landing page. Rate limited to 10 req/min.

Public endpoint for clients/leads to submit their onboarding intake form. Requires a valid intake token. Transitions client from INTAKE_SENT to ACTIVE, or lead from NEW to INTAKE_COMPLETE. Rate limited to 10 req/min.

get.description: Returns the client/lead name for an intake form page. Requires a valid token as query parameter.
Returns all WhatsApp Flows from the Meta API. **Requires platform admin role.**

post.description: Creates a new WhatsApp Flow of type weekly_checkin or workout_log. **Requires platform admin role.**
Publishes a draft WhatsApp Flow. **Requires platform admin role.**
Sends a WhatsApp check-in Flow to a specific client.

post.summary: Send workout log flow to client

get.description: Returns all WhatsApp message templates registered with Meta for this Business Account.

post.description: Batch-registers all FitFlow message templates with Meta's WhatsApp API.
Parses a natural language exercise command and returns matching exercises for selection.

get.description: Meta sends a GET request with a challenge token during webhook registration. Returns the challenge if the verify token matches META_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN.

post.description: Receives inbound messages, delivery statuses, and Flow responses from Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API. Signature verified via X-Hub-Signature-256 header using META_APP_SECRET. Always returns 200 immediately; processing is async.
Receives messages and callback queries from Telegram Bot API. Verified via X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header matching TG_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Returns 200 immediately; processing is async.

Handles checkout.session.completed events from Stripe. Uses express.raw() for signature verification with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Creates Payment record and transitions client PENDING_PAYMENT -> INTAKE_SENT.

Handles subscription lifecycle events: customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted, invoice.payment_succeeded/failed, customer.subscription.trial_will_end. Uses express.raw() with STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
